days.title: A New Year with God
days.verse: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
lines: Faithful God,
before this year has made a single promise,
You have already kept Yours.
Your mercies are new this morning,
and they will be new every morning after it.
I give You the days I can see
and the ones I cannot.
Walk ahead of me into this year,
and let me end it closer to You than I began.
Amen.

days.title: Order My Steps
days.verse: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
lines: Lord,
the steps of a good man are ordered by You,
so I bring You my feet before I bring You my plans.
Where I would rush, slow me down.
Where I would stop, give me courage to keep walking.
Let every step today be one You have ordered,
and let me delight in the way You lead.
Amen.

days.title: First Things First
days.verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
lines: Father,
I want to seek You first,
not after the phone, the news and the worries.
Be the first voice I hear today.
Put Your kingdom at the top of my list
and let everything else find its right place under it.
I trust You with all these things I need.
Amen.

days.title: A Clean Heart
days.verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
lines: Create in me a clean heart, O God.
Wash away what I carried into this new season
that does not belong to You.
Renew a right spirit within me,
steady and willing and true.
Let my heart be a place You are glad to live in.
In Jesus' name. Amen.

days.title: Morning Prayer
days.verse: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
lines: Lord,
in the morning You hear my voice.
Before the noise of the day begins,
I lay my prayer before You
and I look up, expecting You to answer.
Teach me the habit of meeting You first,
so that wherever this day takes me,
I am already Yours.
Amen.

days.title: The Light Has Come
days.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the wise men followed a star until they found You,
and the light of the world was a child in a house.
Arise in me today and let me shine.
Let Your glory rise upon my home, my work and my words,
so that someone looking for You
finds their way because of me.
Amen.

days.title: Little by Little
days.verse: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
lines: Father,
do not let me despise the day of small things.
The small prayer, the short reading, the quiet minute:
You see them and You are pleased.
Build my life with You one faithful day at a time,
until what was small becomes strong.
Amen.

days.title: Write the Vision
days.verse: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
lines: Lord,
give me a vision for this year that comes from You.
Make it plain enough to write down
and clear enough to run with.
Where my plans are only mine, change them.
Where they are Yours, give me patience to wait for them,
for they will surely come.
Amen.

days.title: Teach Me to Number My Days
days.verse: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
lines: Eternal God,
teach me to number my days,
so that I do not waste the ones You give me.
Let me not spend this year on what does not last.
Give me a heart of wisdom
that knows what matters to You
and gives its best hours to it.
Amen.

days.title: A Lamp for My Feet
days.verse: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
lines: Lord,
Your word is a lamp to my feet.
I do not need to see the whole road,
only the next step, lit by You.
Give me a hunger for Scripture this year.
Let me open it daily,
and let it light the way I walk.
Amen.

days.title: Forget the Former Things
days.verse: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
lines: Father,
You tell me not to keep staring at the former things.
You are doing a new thing,
and it is already springing up.
Open my eyes to see it.
Make a way where I see no way,
and rivers where my life feels dry.
Amen.

days.title: In Quietness and Confidence
days.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
lines: Holy God,
my strength is not in hurry but in quietness and confidence in You.
Teach me to return and rest.
When I want to fix everything at once,
let me first sit with You.
Grow in me a calm that comes from trusting You.
Amen.

days.title: Commit Your Way
days.verse: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
lines: Lord,
I commit my way to You today:
my work, my family, my money, my fears.
I trust You with what I cannot control.
Bring to pass what is good,
and close the doors that would harm me.
My way is safer in Your hands than in mine.
Amen.

days.title: A Willing Heart
days.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
lines: Lord,
when You ask, Whom shall I send,
let me be quick to answer, Here am I.
I do not need to be great to be useful to You,
only willing.
Send me where I am needed today,
even if it is only across the room.
Amen.

days.title: Abide in the Vine
days.verse: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
lines: Jesus,
You are the vine and I am a branch.
Without You I can do nothing that lasts.
Keep me close to You today,
drawing life from You and not from my own strength.
Let my life bear fruit that others can taste.
Amen.

days.title: One Thing I Ask
days.verse: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
lines: Lord,
one thing I ask above all others:
to dwell in Your house all the days of my life,
to behold Your beauty and to seek You.
When I want many things, bring me back to this one.
Let being near You be enough for me.
Amen.

days.title: Fresh Discipline
days.verse: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness. For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
lines: Father,
I train my body for this life;
help me also train my soul for godliness.
Build habits in me that make room for You:
prayer, Scripture, rest and kindness.
Make these practices a joy and not a chore,
for they hold promise for this life and the next.
Amen.

days.title: Wait on the Lord
days.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
lines: Lord,
I am waiting on You for things I cannot rush.
Renew my strength while I wait.
Let me rise up like an eagle above discouragement,
run and not be weary,
walk and not faint.
You are worth waiting for.
Amen.

days.title: Trust Without Understanding
days.verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
lines: Lord,
I trust You with all my heart,
even the parts that do not understand.
I will not lean on my own understanding today.
In every decision I will acknowledge You,
and I believe You will make my path straight.
Amen.

days.title: Your Word in My Heart
days.verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
lines: Lord,
hide Your word in my heart
so that it is there when I need it most.
Let a verse I read today come back to me
in the moment of temptation or fear.
Fill my memory with Your truth
until it shapes how I think.
Amen.

days.title: Strength for the Journey
days.verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
lines: Lord,
You go before me and You are with me.
You will not fail me or forsake me.
So I will not fear and I will not be dismayed.
Whatever is ahead in this year,
You are already there.
Amen.

days.title: Search Me
days.verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
lines: Search me, O God, and know my heart.
Show me anything in me that grieves You,
the attitude I defend and the habit I excuse.
Do not leave me as I am.
Lead me in the way everlasting,
gently and surely.
Amen.

days.title: Daily Bread
days.verse: Give us this day our daily bread.
lines: Father,
give me this day my daily bread.
Not a year's supply, just enough for today,
so that I come back to You tomorrow.
Provide for my needs and for those I love.
Teach me to trust You one day at a time.
Amen.

days.title: Do Not Grow Weary
days.verse: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
lines: Lord,
I am tempted to give up on the good I started.
Keep me from growing weary in doing well.
Remind me that harvest comes in due season
if I do not lose heart.
Give me strength to keep sowing today.
Amen.

days.title: A New Creation
days.verse: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
lines: Jesus,
in You I am a new creation.
The old has gone and the new has come.
Let me stop living as if I am still the old me.
Help me walk today in who You have made me,
forgiven, free and made new.
Amen.

days.title: Planted by the Water
days.verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
lines: Lord,
make me like a tree planted by rivers of water,
rooted deep, bearing fruit in its season,
with leaves that do not wither.
When dry days come, keep me drinking from You.
Let whatever I do prosper in Your hands.
Amen.

days.title: Faithful in Little
days.verse: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
lines: Father,
teach me to be faithful in the little things:
the promise I made, the task no one sees,
the money that is not much.
Let my faithfulness in small things
prepare me for whatever You trust me with next.
Amen.

days.title: Draw Near
days.verse: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
lines: Lord,
You promise that if I draw near to You,
You will draw near to me.
So here I am, coming closer.
Meet me in this moment.
Let me feel Your nearness today
in the ordinary places of my life.
Amen.

days.title: Run the Race
days.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
lines: Jesus,
help me lay aside every weight that slows me down
and the sin that so easily trips me.
Let me run with patience the race set before me,
looking to You,
the author and finisher of my faith.
Amen.

days.title: Whatever You Do
days.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
lines: Lord,
whatever I do today, let me do it heartily, as for You.
The emails, the cooking, the cleaning, the meetings:
let all of it be worship.
When no one notices my work,
remind me that You do.
Amen.

days.title: He Who Began a Good Work
days.verse: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ.
lines: Faithful Father,
as this first month ends,
I thank You for every step You helped me take.
You began a good work in me
and You will carry it on to completion.
I am not finished, but I am in Your hands.
Amen.

days.title: Loved Before I Loved
days.verse: We love him, because he first loved us.
lines: Father,
I love You because You first loved me.
Before I knew Your name, You knew mine.
Let this month teach me how loved I am,
so that I can love others from a full heart
and not an empty one.
Amen.

days.title: Fearfully Made
days.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
lines: Creator God,
I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
When I look in the mirror and see only flaws,
remind me that You made me on purpose.
Heal the way I speak about myself.
Let me praise You for the work of Your hands, even me.
Amen.

days.title: Love Is Patient
days.verse: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up.
lines: Lord,
love is patient and love is kind,
and I am not always either.
Give me patience with the people closest to me
and kindness when I am tired.
Let my love look more like Yours today,
slow to anger and quick to be gentle.
Amen.

days.title: Nothing Can Separate Us
days.verse: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
lines: Lord Jesus,
nothing can separate me from Your love:
not death, not life, not my past,
not what I fear about tomorrow.
When I feel far from You,
hold me by this promise.
I am Yours and I am loved.
Amen.

days.title: Healing for Broken Hearts
days.verse: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
lines: Healer,
You heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds.
You know the places in me that still hurt,
the words that cut and the people who left.
Bind up what is broken,
gently and fully, in Your time.
Amen.

days.title: A Gentle Answer
days.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
lines: Lord,
a soft answer turns away wrath.
Before I reply in anger today, stop my tongue.
Give me gentle words in hard conversations.
Let my home be a place where voices are calm
and hearts feel safe.
Amen.

days.title: Bear One Another
days.verse: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
lines: Father,
show me whose burden I can help carry today.
Make me alert to the friend who is quietly struggling.
Let me give my time, my ear and my prayers,
and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Amen.

days.title: For My Marriage
days.verse: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
lines: Lord,
a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
Be the third strand in my marriage,
or in the one I am praying for.
Bind us together in You.
Where we have pulled apart, draw us close again.
Amen.

days.title: Forgive as Forgiven
days.verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
lines: Jesus,
You forgave me completely,
so teach me to forgive the one who hurt me.
I cannot do it in my own strength.
Soften what has become hard in me.
Let me release the debt as You released mine.
Amen.

days.title: For My Children
days.verse: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
lines: Father,
I bring my children before You,
the ones I have and the ones I hope for.
Teach them Yourself.
Let great be their peace.
Guard their hearts, their friendships and their futures.
Amen.

days.title: Love Your Neighbour
days.verse: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
lines: Lord,
You told me to love my neighbour as myself.
Show me my neighbour today:
the one next door, at work, in the market,
the stranger who needs a kind word.
Let my love be practical and real.
Amen.

days.title: Clothed in Love
days.verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
lines: Father,
above all things I want to put on love,
the bond that holds everything together.
When I dress this morning,
let me put on kindness and humility too.
Let people feel Your love when they are near me.
Amen.

days.title: Honour One Another
days.verse: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another.
lines: Lord,
give me a heart that honours others above myself.
Let me celebrate the success of my friends
without envy or comparison.
Teach me to be warm and devoted
to the people You have placed around me.
Amen.

days.title: God Is Love
days.verse: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
lines: God of love,
today the world talks about love,
but You are love itself.
Thank You for every person who has loved me well.
Bless those who feel alone today.
Let them know they are seen and dearly loved by You.
Amen.

days.title: Rooted in Love
days.verse: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love, May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
lines: Lord Jesus,
dwell in my heart by faith.
Root me and ground me in Your love,
so I can grasp how wide and long and high and deep it is.
Fill me with the fullness of God,
more than I can understand.
Amen.

days.title: For My Friends
days.verse: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
lines: Father,
thank You for friends who love at all times.
Bless the friends who have stood by me in hard seasons.
Make me that kind of friend,
faithful when it is costly,
and present when it is inconvenient.
Amen.

days.title: When I Feel Unlovable
days.verse: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
lines: Lord,
You have loved me with an everlasting love.
Not a love that runs out when I fail,
but one that draws me back with kindness.
When I feel unlovable,
let Your everlasting love speak louder.
Amen.

days.title: Peacemaker
days.verse: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
lines: Prince of Peace,
blessed are the peacemakers.
Use me to bring peace where there is tension:
in my family, my church, my workplace.
Give me wisdom to know when to speak
and when to simply listen.
Amen.

days.title: Speak Life
days.verse: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
lines: Lord,
let no corrupt word come out of my mouth today.
Let my words build up and not tear down.
Give me something good to say
to the person who needs it most,
words that carry grace.
Amen.

days.title: The Prodigal Returns
days.verse: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
lines: Father,
You ran to the son who came home.
I pray for the one I love who has wandered far.
Bring them to their senses and turn them toward home.
And when they come,
give me a heart that runs to meet them too.
Amen.

days.title: Love in Action
days.verse: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
lines: Lord,
let me not love only in word,
but in deed and in truth.
Show me one practical way to love someone today:
a meal, a visit, a call, a gift.
Let my love be something people can touch.
Amen.

days.title: Accepted in the Beloved
days.verse: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
lines: Father,
I am accepted in the Beloved.
I do not have to earn Your approval.
I am not on probation with You.
Let this truth settle the anxious part of me
that is always trying to prove itself.
Amen.

days.title: Healing Family Wounds
days.verse: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
lines: Lord,
turn the hearts of fathers to their children
and children to their fathers.
Heal the old wounds in my family line.
Where there is silence, bring conversation.
Where there is coldness, bring warmth again.
Amen.

days.title: Kind to the Unkind
days.verse: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You are kind to the unthankful and the evil,
so help me be kind to the person who is unkind to me.
Guard my heart from bitterness.
Let my response surprise them
and point them to You.
Amen.

days.title: Love Covers
days.verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
lines: Father,
fervent love covers a multitude of sins.
Help me cover the faults of others
instead of exposing them.
Let me not keep a record of wrongs.
Make my love deep enough to forgive often.
Amen.

days.title: For Those Who Are Single
days.verse: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
lines: Lord,
You set the lonely in families.
I pray for every single heart that longs for companionship.
Fill them with Your presence now,
surround them with true friends,
and lead them in Your perfect time.
Amen.

days.title: Lay Down My Life
days.verse: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
lines: Jesus,
greater love has no one than this,
that a man lay down his life for his friends.
You did that for me.
Teach me to lay down my pride, my time, my comfort,
for the people You have given me to love.
Amen.

days.title: Love Never Fails
days.verse: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
lines: Lord,
everything else will pass away,
but love never fails.
Let what I build this year be built in love.
Thank You for teaching me this month
that Your love is the key to every relationship.
Amen.

days.title: A Day of Grace
days.verse: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
lines: Father,
this extra day is a gift from You,
a day that only comes once in four years.
Let me not waste it.
I will rejoice and be glad in it,
and give it back to You with thanks.
Amen.

days.title: Be Still
days.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
lines: Lord,
You say, Be still, and know that I am God.
My mind is loud this morning.
Quiet the noise inside me.
Let me sit with You for one minute without asking for anything,
just knowing that You are God and I am not.
Amen.

days.title: Cast Your Cares
days.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
lines: Father,
I cast all my cares on You, because You care for me.
Here is the worry about money,
the worry about my health,
the worry about the people I love.
I put them in Your hands and I leave them there.
Amen.

days.title: Peace That Guards
days.verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
lines: Lord,
I will not be anxious about anything today.
Instead I bring You everything in prayer, with thanks.
Let Your peace, which passes all understanding,
stand guard over my heart and my mind
through Christ Jesus.
Amen.

days.title: He Gives Sleep
days.verse: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
lines: Father,
You give Your beloved sleep.
Tonight, take the thoughts that keep me awake.
I do not need to solve everything before I rest.
Let me lie down in peace,
because You do not sleep and You are watching over me.
Amen.

days.title: Come to Me
days.verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
lines: Jesus,
You invite the weary and heavy laden to come to You.
I am tired in my body and tired in my soul.
I come now.
Give me the rest You promised,
the kind that sleep alone cannot give.
Amen.

days.title: Perfect Peace
days.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
lines: Lord,
You keep in perfect peace the mind that is stayed on You.
My mind keeps drifting to fear.
Bring it back to You again and again today.
Let my thoughts rest on who You are,
not on what might happen.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
days.verse: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
lines: Good Shepherd,
because You are my shepherd, I lack nothing I truly need.
Make me lie down in green pastures.
Lead me beside still waters.
Slow my anxious pace to match Yours,
and restore my soul.
Amen.

days.title: Do Not Worry About Tomorrow
days.verse: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
lines: Jesus,
You said tomorrow will worry about itself.
I keep living in tomorrow's problems.
Bring me back into today,
where Your grace is enough
and Your help is already here.
Amen.

days.title: My Refuge
days.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
lines: Most High God,
I dwell in Your secret place
and rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
You are my refuge and my fortress.
In You I trust.
Shelter me from every fear that rises today.
Amen.

days.title: Not a Spirit of Fear
days.verse: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
lines: Father,
You have not given me a spirit of fear,
but of power, of love and of a sound mind.
I reject the fear that grips me.
Fill me with power and love,
and settle my mind in You.
Amen.

days.title: A Quiet Place
days.verse: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
lines: Jesus,
You told Your tired disciples to come apart and rest a while.
Show me how to make a quiet place in my busy day.
Help me turn off the noise
and find a few moments alone with You.
Amen.

days.title: When My Heart Is Overwhelmed
days.verse: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
lines: Lord,
from the end of the earth I cry to You
when my heart is overwhelmed.
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Lift me above this flood of feelings
and set my feet on You.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Will Fight
days.verse: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
lines: Father,
the Lord shall fight for me, and I shall hold my peace.
I stop striving to defend myself in this battle.
I step back and let You fight for me.
I will hold my peace and watch You work.
Amen.

days.title: Peace I Leave You
days.verse: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You leave me Your peace,
not the kind the world gives and takes away.
Do not let my heart be troubled today.
Do not let it be afraid.
I receive Your peace now.
Amen.

days.title: Wait Patiently
days.verse: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
lines: Lord,
teach me to rest in You and wait patiently.
Do not let me fret over those who seem to prosper
while I wait.
Your timing is not late.
Let my soul be quiet while You work.
Amen.

days.title: In the Storm
days.verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
lines: Jesus,
You spoke to the wind and the waves, Peace, be still,
and there was a great calm.
Speak those words over the storm in my life.
Calm the wind around me
and the waves inside me.
Amen.

days.title: Your Thoughts Are Higher
days.verse: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
lines: Lord,
Your thoughts are not my thoughts,
and Your ways are higher than my ways.
When I cannot understand what You are doing,
let me rest in knowing You understand.
I trust Your higher ways.
Amen.

days.title: Rest for the Soul
days.verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
lines: Jesus,
I take Your yoke upon me and learn from You,
for You are gentle and lowly in heart.
Teach me Your gentleness.
Let my soul find the rest it has been searching for
in You alone.
Amen.

days.title: Guard My Mind
days.verse: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
lines: Father,
fill my mind today with what is true, honest and just,
pure, lovely and of good report.
Guard me from scrolling into fear and comparison.
Let me think on the good things You have done.
Amen.

days.title: My Soul Waits
days.verse: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
lines: Lord,
truly my soul waits upon You.
From You comes my salvation.
I stop running to everything else for comfort.
Let my soul be silent before You,
waiting and trusting.
Amen.

days.title: Unhurried Love
days.verse: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
lines: Lord,
You are merciful and gracious,
slow to anger and plenteous in mercy.
You are never in a hurry with me.
Make me unhurried with others,
patient and kind like You.
Amen.

days.title: Fear Not
days.verse: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
lines: Father,
You say, Fear thou not, for I am with thee.
Be not dismayed, for I am thy God.
Strengthen me today.
Help me.
Hold me up with the right hand of Your righteousness.
Amen.

days.title: Quiet Trust
days.verse: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
lines: Lord,
I have calmed and quieted my soul,
like a weaned child with its mother.
I do not need to understand everything.
I rest in You like a child at peace,
held and content.
Amen.

days.title: Lay It Down
days.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
lines: Lord,
I cast my burden upon You, and You will sustain me.
You will never let the righteous be moved.
I lay this weight down at Your feet.
Hold me steady where I am weak.
Amen.

days.title: Mary's Yes
days.verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
lines: Lord,
Mary said, Be it unto me according to thy word.
Give me a heart that says yes to You
even when I do not understand.
Let Your word be fulfilled in my life,
and let my answer be quiet trust.
Amen.

days.title: Hidden in Christ
days.verse: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
lines: Father,
my life is hidden with Christ in You.
I do not need the world's noise to tell me who I am.
Let me find my identity in the quiet place
where I am known and kept by You.
Amen.

days.title: Silence the Accuser
days.verse: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
lines: Lord Jesus,
there is now no condemnation for those who are in You.
Silence the accusing voice that replays my failures.
I am forgiven.
Let me walk in that freedom today.
Amen.

days.title: Morning by Morning
days.verse: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
lines: Lord,
wake me morning by morning
and open my ear to hear You as one who is taught.
Give me the tongue of the learned,
that I may speak a word in season to the weary.
Amen.

days.title: My Times Are in Your Hand
days.verse: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
lines: Father,
my times are in Your hand.
The delays, the deadlines, the waiting:
all of it is held by You.
I do not need to control the clock.
I rest in Your timing.
Amen.

days.title: He Restores
days.verse: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
lines: Good Shepherd,
You restore my soul.
Where I am worn thin, restore me.
Lead me in paths of righteousness for Your name's sake,
one quiet step at a time.
Amen.

days.title: Stillness Learned
days.verse: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
lines: Lord,
I will both lay me down in peace and sleep,
for You alone make me dwell in safety.
Thank You for teaching me stillness this month.
Let peace be my new habit,
not just a visitor.
Amen.

days.title: All Things New
days.verse: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
lines: Lord,
You sit on the throne and say, Behold, I make all things new.
Not some things. All things.
Take what is tired and worn in me
and begin again.
Let this month be a season of renewal
in my soul, my home and my faith.
Amen.

days.title: Renewed Day by Day
days.verse: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
lines: Father,
my body gets tired and my strength runs low,
but my inward man is renewed day by day.
Renew me again this morning.
Let what is happening inside me
be stronger than what is wearing me down outside.
Amen.

days.title: Transformed Mind
days.verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
lines: Lord,
I do not want to be shaped by the world around me.
Transform me by the renewing of my mind.
Change the way I think about money, success and myself,
until I can see clearly
what Your good and perfect will is.
Amen.

days.title: Spring Rain
days.verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
lines: Lord,
I want to know You more and more.
You come to me like the rain,
like the spring rain that waters the earth.
Rain on the dry places in my heart today
and let something green begin to grow.
Amen.

days.title: Restore the Joy
days.verse: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
lines: Father,
restore to me the joy of Your salvation.
I remember when my faith felt alive and fresh.
Bring that joy back again.
Hold me up with Your free spirit,
willing and glad to follow You.
Amen.

days.title: The Seed Must Fall
days.verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
lines: Jesus,
a seed must fall into the ground and die
before it bears much fruit.
Show me what needs to die in me,
the pride, the fear, the old way of doing things,
so that new life can grow.
Amen.

days.title: Revive Me
days.verse: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
lines: Lord,
will You not revive us again,
that Your people may rejoice in You?
Start the revival in me.
Wake up what has gone to sleep in my faith.
Let my church and my home rejoice in You again.
Amen.

days.title: Put Off, Put On
days.verse: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts; And be renewed in the spirit of your mind; And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
lines: Father,
help me take off the old self like a worn coat,
with its habits and lies and bitterness.
Renew me in the spirit of my mind.
Let me put on the new self You created,
true and holy and good.
Amen.

days.title: The Potter's Hands
days.verse: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
lines: Lord,
when the clay was spoiled in the potter's hand,
he did not throw it away. He made it again.
I feel spoiled in places.
Do not throw me away.
Shape me again into something that pleases You.
Amen.

days.title: Second Chances
days.verse: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying.
lines: Lord,
the word came to Jonah a second time.
Thank You for being the God of second chances.
I ran from You before.
Speak to me again,
and this time let me obey.
Amen.

days.title: Growing in Grace
days.verse: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
lines: Lord Jesus,
I want to grow in grace and in the knowledge of You.
Do not let me stay the same year after year.
Grow my patience, my kindness and my understanding.
Let this spring be a growing season in my soul.
Amen.

days.title: Waiting for Fruit
days.verse: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
lines: Father,
the farmer waits patiently for the early and latter rain.
Teach me to wait like that for growth in my life.
I want change overnight,
but You grow things in seasons.
Make me patient with my own growth.
Amen.

days.title: Rivers in the Desert
days.verse: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
lines: Lord,
You make the wilderness glad and the desert bloom like a rose.
Look at the dry places in my life.
Make them blossom again.
Let people see beauty where there was only dust,
and give You the glory.
Amen.

days.title: The Gardener
days.verse: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
lines: Father,
You are the gardener of my life.
When You prune me, it hurts,
but You only cut so I can bear more fruit.
Help me trust Your hands,
even when You take away things I wanted to keep.
Amen.

days.title: Seek and Find
days.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
lines: Lord,
You promise that I will find You
when I seek You with all my heart.
I have been seeking You with half a heart.
Today I give You the whole of it.
Let me find You fresh again.
Amen.

days.title: A Heart of Flesh
days.verse: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
lines: Lord,
take away my heart of stone,
the part of me that has grown cold and hard.
Give me a heart of flesh,
soft toward You and tender toward others.
Put Your Spirit within me.
Amen.

days.title: Living Water
days.verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
lines: Jesus,
You offer water that becomes a spring within me.
I keep drinking from wells that leave me thirsty.
Today I come to You.
Let Your living water rise in me
and overflow into the lives around me.
Amen.

days.title: Return to Me
days.verse: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
lines: Lord,
You say, Turn to me with all your heart.
I have drifted, little by little.
I turn back now.
You are gracious and merciful, slow to anger and of great kindness.
Receive me as I return.
Amen.

days.title: From Glory to Glory
days.verse: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
lines: Lord,
as I look at You,
I am being changed into Your image from glory to glory.
Let me spend time looking at You today,
in Your word and in prayer,
so that I slowly become more like You.
Amen.

days.title: Thirsty Ground
days.verse: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring.
lines: Father,
You promise to pour water on the thirsty
and floods on the dry ground.
I am thirsty for You.
Pour out Your Spirit on me and on my children,
and let us spring up like grass by the streams.
Amen.

days.title: Come Out of the Grave
days.verse: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth. And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
lines: Jesus,
You called Lazarus out of the grave,
and then told them to loose him and let him go.
Call me out of whatever has buried me.
Then loose me from the grave clothes,
the old habits that still bind me.
Amen.

days.title: The Earth Is the Lord's
days.verse: [A Psalm of David.] The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
lines: Creator God,
the earth is Yours and everything in it.
Thank You for spring, for flowers and new leaves.
Teach me to care for Your creation
and to see Your hand in every growing thing.
Amen.

days.title: Renewed Strength
days.verse: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
lines: Lord,
You satisfy my mouth with good things,
so that my youth is renewed like the eagle's.
When I feel old and tired in my faith,
renew me.
Let me rise again with fresh strength.
Amen.

days.title: Wash Me
days.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
lines: Lord,
wash me and I shall be whiter than snow.
I bring You the stains I cannot remove myself.
Make me clean again.
Let me walk today
with the lightness of someone forgiven.
Amen.

days.title: Grow Up into Him
days.verse: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ.
lines: Lord Jesus,
help me grow up into You in all things.
Not only in what I know,
but in how I love and speak and live.
Let me speak the truth in love
and grow a little more mature today.
Amen.

days.title: Seasons
days.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
lines: Father,
to everything there is a season.
You know which season I am in right now.
Help me not to wish it away.
Teach me what this season is meant to grow in me,
and let me trust You for the next one.
Amen.

days.title: Deep Roots
days.verse: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is. For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
lines: Lord,
blessed is the one who trusts in You.
Make me like a tree whose roots go down to the river.
When the heat comes, let me not be afraid.
When the dry year comes,
let me keep bearing fruit.
Amen.

days.title: A New Song
days.verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
lines: Lord,
You have put a new song in my mouth.
I am tired of singing the old songs of complaint.
Teach me to praise You in fresh ways.
Let many see it and fear,
and put their trust in You.
Amen.

days.title: Fresh Every Morning
days.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
lines: Father,
You are in the midst of me, mighty to save.
You rejoice over me with joy
and You rest in Your love.
You even sing over me.
Let me wake up tomorrow knowing that I am Your delight.
Amen.

days.title: Spring Has Come
days.verse: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone; The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land.
lines: Lord,
the winter is past and the rain is over.
The flowers appear on the earth.
Thank You for the renewal You worked in me this month.
Let what You planted keep growing,
and let me sing in this new season.
Amen.

days.title: Created for Good Works
days.verse: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
lines: Father,
I am Your workmanship,
created in Christ Jesus for good works
that You prepared before I was born.
Show me the work You have prepared for me today.
Let me walk in it gladly.
Amen.

days.title: Known Before Birth
days.verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
lines: Lord,
before You formed me in the womb, You knew me.
Before I was born, You set me apart.
My life is not an accident.
Remind me today that You made me with a purpose,
and lead me into it.
Amen.

days.title: Here I Am
days.verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
lines: Lord,
like Samuel in the night, I say,
Speak, for Your servant is listening.
Quiet the other voices.
Tell me what You want me to do,
and give me the courage to do it.
Amen.

days.title: Salt and Light
days.verse: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men. Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
lines: Jesus,
You call me the salt of the earth and the light of the world.
Let my life add flavour and bring light
wherever I go today.
Do not let me hide what You have put in me.
Amen.

days.title: My Gift to Serve
days.verse: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
lines: Father,
You gave me a gift to serve others with.
Show me clearly what it is.
Do not let me bury it out of fear or comparison.
Let me use it today as a good steward
of Your many-sided grace.
Amen.

days.title: The Plans You Have
days.verse: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
lines: Lord,
You know the plans You have for me,
plans of peace and not of evil,
to give me a future and a hope.
When I cannot see my path,
let me trust that You can.
Amen.

days.title: For Such a Time
days.verse: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
lines: Lord,
Esther came to the kingdom for such a time as this.
Maybe I am where I am for a reason too.
Give me the courage to speak and act
when You place me in the right place
at the right moment.
Amen.

days.title: Work as Worship
days.verse: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
lines: Creator God,
You placed man in the garden to work it and keep it.
Work was Your gift before the fall.
Let me see my job as a garden You have given me.
Help me tend it well
and with a thankful heart.
Amen.

days.title: Faithful Servant
days.verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
lines: Lord,
I long to one day hear You say,
Well done, good and faithful servant.
Help me be faithful with the few things You have given me today.
Let me enter into Your joy.
Amen.

days.title: For Mothers
days.verse: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
lines: Father,
thank You for my mother and for every woman
who has mothered me in faith.
Her children rise up and call her blessed.
Bless the mothers who are tired today,
and comfort those who are grieving one.
Amen.

days.title: Steps Directed
days.verse: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
lines: Lord,
my heart plans my way, but You direct my steps.
I hold my plans with open hands today.
Change them if You need to.
I would rather walk Your way
than arrive where I planned without You.
Amen.

days.title: Do It Heartily
days.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
lines: Father,
whatever my hand finds to do,
let me do it with all my might.
Keep me from doing half-hearted work.
Let excellence in small things
be my quiet way of honouring You.
Amen.

days.title: One Body
days.verse: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
lines: Lord,
You set each member in the body as it pleased You.
I do not have to be someone else.
Help me find my place in Your church
and serve there with joy,
not envy.
Amen.

days.title: Go and Make Disciples
days.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
lines: Jesus,
You sent Your followers to make disciples.
Show me one person I can encourage in faith today.
Give me natural words to share You.
And remind me You are with me always,
even to the end of the age.
Amen.

days.title: Not by Might
days.verse: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
lines: Lord,
not by might, nor by power, but by Your Spirit.
I cannot fulfil my calling in my own strength.
Let Your Spirit do through me
what I could never do alone.
Amen.

days.title: Lead Me
days.verse: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
lines: Lord,
cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning,
for in You do I trust.
Cause me to know the way I should walk,
for I lift up my soul to You.
Show me today's next step.
Amen.

days.title: The Talents
days.verse: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
lines: Father,
You give to each according to their ability.
Do not let me compare my portion with anyone else's.
Help me invest what You gave me
and multiply it for Your kingdom.
Amen.

days.title: Walk Worthy
days.verse: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called.
lines: Lord,
help me walk worthy of the calling I have received.
Let my daily life match what I believe.
In my words, my money and my relationships,
let me live like someone who belongs to You.
Amen.

days.title: Fishers of Men
days.verse: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
lines: Jesus,
You said, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
The disciples left their nets that day.
Show me what nets I need to leave
to follow You more closely.
Amen.

days.title: Ask for Wisdom
days.verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
lines: Father,
I do not know what to do about this decision.
You promise wisdom to anyone who asks,
without scolding.
So I ask now.
Give me wisdom generously and make the way clear.
Amen.

days.title: Called by Name
days.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
lines: Lord,
You have called me by my name and I am Yours.
I do not need a title to matter to You.
Let me live today as someone who is known
and chosen by God.
Amen.

days.title: Servant of All
days.verse: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all. For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
lines: Jesus,
You came not to be served but to serve.
In a world that wants to be first,
teach me to be the servant.
Show me how to serve someone quietly today,
the way You served me.
Amen.

days.title: Small Beginnings
days.verse: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
lines: Lord,
Your kingdom is like a mustard seed,
small when it is planted and great when it grows.
Do not let me despise my small start.
Grow what You planted in me
into something that gives shelter to others.
Amen.

days.title: The Holy Spirit Comes
days.verse: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You promised power when the Holy Spirit comes upon me.
Fill me with that power today.
Make me Your witness at home, in my city,
and to the ends of the earth.
Amen.

days.title: Open Doors
days.verse: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
lines: Lord,
You set before me an open door that no one can shut.
Show me which doors You have opened.
Give me courage to walk through them,
and peace about the ones You have closed.
Amen.

days.title: Not Ashamed
days.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
lines: Lord,
I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ.
It is the power of God to everyone who believes.
Give me boldness to let people know I follow You,
at work, among friends and online.
Amen.

days.title: Let Your Light Shine
days.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
lines: Father,
let my light shine before others today
so they see good works and glorify You.
Let the light point to You and not to me.
Make my good deeds a doorway
for someone to find You.
Amen.

days.title: A Heart After Yours
days.verse: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
lines: Lord,
David was a man after Your own heart.
I want my heart to beat for what Yours beats for.
Let me care for the poor, the lost and the broken.
Make me someone who will fulfil all Your will.
Amen.

days.title: Rest in the Work
days.verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God. For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
lines: Father,
there remains a rest for Your people.
Even in my calling, let me not burn out.
Teach me to work from rest,
not rest only after I collapse.
Amen.

days.title: Workers in the Harvest
days.verse: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few; Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
lines: Lord of the harvest,
the harvest is plenty and the workers are few.
Send out workers into Your field.
Give them courage, compassion and joy.
And if You are sending me,
here I am, ready to go.
Amen.

days.title: To Live Is Christ
days.verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
lines: Jesus,
for me to live is Christ.
Not my career, not my reputation, not my comfort.
Thank You for showing me more of my purpose this month.
Let every day of my life be about You.
Amen.

days.title: Be Strong and Courageous
days.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
lines: Lord,
You told Joshua, Be strong and of a good courage.
Be not afraid, for I am with thee whithersoever thou goest.
I need that word today.
Wherever I go, You go.
Make me brave.
Amen.

days.title: My Strength and Song
days.verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
lines: Lord,
You are my strength and my song,
and You have become my salvation.
When I feel weak, be my strength.
When I feel low, be my song.
Let me praise You before I see the victory.
Amen.

days.title: Strength in Weakness
days.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
lines: Jesus,
Your grace is enough for me,
and Your strength is made perfect in my weakness.
I stop hiding my weakness from You.
Let Your power rest on me right where I feel I cannot cope.
Amen.

days.title: A Very Present Help
days.verse: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.] God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
lines: God,
You are my refuge and strength,
a very present help in trouble.
Not distant, not late, but present.
Be present with me in this trouble today.
I will not fear.
Amen.

days.title: I Can Do All Things
days.verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
lines: Lord Jesus,
I can do all things through You who strengthen me.
Not because I am strong,
but because You are.
Strengthen me for what I am facing today.
Amen.

days.title: Through the Fire
days.verse: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
lines: Father,
when I pass through the waters, You will be with me.
When I walk through the fire, I will not be burned.
I am in the fire now.
Walk with me in it,
and bring me out without the smell of smoke.
Amen.

days.title: Lift Up My Eyes
days.verse: [A Song of degrees.] I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
lines: Lord,
I lift up my eyes to the hills.
Where does my help come from?
My help comes from You,
who made heaven and earth.
I look up from my problem to You.
Amen.

days.title: The Giant Will Fall
days.verse: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
lines: Lord,
David faced Goliath in Your name, not with a sword.
The giant in front of me looks big.
But You are bigger.
I face it today in the name of the Lord of hosts.
Amen.

days.title: Pressed but Not Crushed
days.verse: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed.
lines: Lord,
I am troubled on every side, yet not distressed,
perplexed, but not in despair,
cast down, but not destroyed.
When life presses in from every side,
hold me together.
Remind me that You are holding me even now.
Amen.

days.title: Wings Like Eagles
days.verse: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
lines: Lord,
You give power to the faint,
and to those with no might You increase strength.
I feel faint today.
Pour Your strength into my tired body and spirit.
Amen.

days.title: Fear Has No Hold
days.verse: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
lines: Lord,
You are my light and my salvation.
Whom shall I fear?
You are the strength of my life.
Of whom shall I be afraid?
Let this truth push fear out of my heart today.
Amen.

days.title: The Valley
days.verse: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
lines: Shepherd,
even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil, for You are with me.
Your rod and Your staff comfort me.
Walk me through this valley.
Amen.

days.title: Armour of God
days.verse: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
lines: Lord,
make me strong in You and in the power of Your might.
I put on Your whole armour today.
Help me stand firm against every scheme of the enemy,
in my mind and in my home.
Amen.

days.title: Hard Pressed Hope
days.verse: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope.
lines: Father,
You say suffering produces patience,
patience produces experience,
and experience produces hope.
Let this hard season not be wasted.
Grow patience in me through it,
and let it end in a hope that does not disappoint.
Amen.

days.title: For Fathers
days.verse: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
lines: Father God,
like a father pities his children, You pity those who fear You.
Thank You for fathers who stayed and loved.
Bless every father trying his best today.
Comfort those who never knew a father's love.
Amen.

days.title: He Will Not Let Me Fall
days.verse: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
lines: Lord,
though I fall, I shall not be utterly cast down,
for You hold me with Your hand.
I have stumbled.
Lift me up.
Let me stand again by Your strength.
Amen.

days.title: The Joy of the Lord
days.verse: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
lines: Lord,
the joy of the Lord is my strength.
When I am discouraged, give me Your joy.
Not a forced smile,
but a deep gladness that I belong to You,
strong enough to carry me through today.
Amen.

days.title: Courage to Speak
days.verse: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word.
lines: Lord,
the early church prayed for boldness when they were threatened.
Give me boldness too.
When I want to stay silent to stay safe,
give me courage.
Let me speak the truth with love,
whatever the cost.
Amen.

days.title: When I Am Afraid
days.verse: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
lines: Lord,
what time I am afraid, I will trust in You.
I am afraid right now.
So right now, I choose to trust You.
Let my trust be louder than my fear.
Amen.

days.title: Stand Firm
days.verse: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
lines: Lord,
help me watch, stand fast in the faith,
act with courage and be strong.
Let all that I do be done in love.
Keep me steady when others give way.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Is My Rock
days.verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
lines: Lord,
You are my rock, my fortress and my deliverer.
You are my strength, in whom I trust.
When everything around me shakes,
You do not.
I stand on You today.
Amen.

days.title: Fight the Good Fight
days.verse: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
lines: Lord,
help me fight the good fight of faith.
Some days faith feels like a battle.
Give me strength not to quit.
Let me lay hold on eternal life
and keep holding on.
Amen.

days.title: Daniel's Courage
days.verse: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
lines: Father,
Daniel kept praying even when it was against the law.
Give me that steady courage.
Let me not hide my faith when it becomes costly.
Keep me faithful in prayer,
whatever happens.
Amen.

days.title: Under His Wings
days.verse: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
lines: Lord,
You cover me with Your feathers,
and under Your wings I find refuge.
Your faithfulness is my shield.
When I feel exposed and unsafe,
hide me close to You.
Amen.

days.title: Hard Places
days.verse: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
lines: Lord,
even if the fig tree does not blossom
and there is no fruit on the vine,
yet I will rejoice in You.
Even if things do not change soon,
I will still praise the God of my salvation.
Amen.

days.title: My Feet Like Hinds' Feet
days.verse: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
lines: Lord God,
You are my strength.
You make my feet like the feet of a deer,
sure and steady on the high places.
Let me walk the hard path ahead of me
without slipping.
Amen.

days.title: Healing and Strength
days.verse: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
lines: Lord,
You promise to restore health and heal wounds.
I bring You my sickness and the sickness of those I love.
Touch our bodies with Your healing.
Give strength to the weak and hope to the sick.
Amen.

days.title: More Than Conquerors
days.verse: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
lines: Lord Jesus,
in all these things I am more than a conqueror
through You who loved me.
Not because the battle is easy,
but because Your love carries me through it.
Amen.

days.title: Wait and Be Strong
days.verse: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
lines: Lord,
I wait on You and I take courage.
You will strengthen my heart.
Wait, I say, on the Lord.
I am tired of waiting,
but I will wait for You a little longer.
Amen.

days.title: He Is Faithful
days.verse: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
lines: Lord,
this I recall to my mind, and therefore I have hope:
it is of Your mercies that I am not consumed.
Thank You for carrying me through this month.
Your faithfulness has been my strength.
Amen.

days.title: Teach Us to Pray
days.verse: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the disciples asked You, Lord, teach us to pray.
I ask You the same today.
Teach me to pray not just with words,
but with honesty and faith.
Make this a month where prayer becomes my home.
Amen.

days.title: Into the Closet
days.verse: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
lines: Father,
You see me in secret.
Help me find a quiet place to shut the door and pray.
I do not need to impress anyone.
Meet me in the secret place,
where it is only You and me.
Amen.

days.title: Pray Without Ceasing
days.verse: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
lines: Lord,
teach me to rejoice always,
to pray without ceasing,
and to give thanks in everything.
I cannot stop and kneel every hour,
but let prayer run under my whole day
like a quiet stream that never runs dry.
Amen.

days.title: Hallowed Be Your Name
days.verse: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
lines: Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be Your name.
Before I ask You for anything,
I want to honour who You are.
You are holy and good.
Let my life make Your name great today.
Amen.

days.title: Your Kingdom Come
days.verse: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
lines: Father,
Your kingdom come, Your will be done
on earth as it is in heaven.
Let Your will be done in my home today,
in my city and in my nation,
just as it is done in heaven.
Amen.

days.title: Ask, Seek, Knock
days.verse: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
lines: Lord,
You told me to ask, to seek and to knock.
I have stopped asking for some things.
Give me faith to ask again,
to keep seeking and to keep knocking.
Amen.

days.title: The Spirit Helps
days.verse: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
lines: Holy Spirit,
sometimes I do not know what to pray.
Thank You for helping me in my weakness
and praying for me with groanings too deep for words.
Pray through me today.
Amen.

days.title: Early in the Morning
days.verse: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
lines: Jesus,
You rose a great while before day and went to pray alone.
If You needed time with the Father,
how much more do I.
Wake me early,
hungry to meet with God.
Amen.

days.title: Lift Up My Voice
days.verse: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
lines: Lord,
I sought You, and You heard me,
and delivered me from all my fears.
Thank You for every prayer You have answered.
Let those memories build my faith
to pray boldly today.
Amen.

days.title: Delight in the Word
days.verse: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
lines: Lord,
I want to delight in Your word
and meditate on it day and night.
Let Scripture be sweet to me,
not a duty I rush through.
Speak to me as I read today.
Amen.

days.title: The Persistent Widow
days.verse: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint.
lines: Jesus,
You told the parable of the widow who kept asking
so that we would always pray and not faint.
I have been praying a long time for this.
Keep me from giving up.
Amen.

days.title: Abide in Prayer
days.verse: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
lines: Lord Jesus,
if I abide in You and Your words abide in me,
I can ask what I will.
Let me stay close to You,
and let my prayers be shaped by Your words.
Amen.

days.title: Worship in Spirit
days.verse: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
lines: Father,
You are Spirit, and You seek those who worship in spirit and in truth.
Let my worship be real today,
not just songs but my whole heart turned to You.
Amen.

days.title: Intercession
days.verse: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men.
lines: Lord,
I bring before You my family, my friends and my leaders.
I pray for those who are sick and those who are lost.
Teach me to stand in the gap for others
and to love them in prayer.
Amen.

days.title: Draw Me
days.verse: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
lines: Lord,
draw me, and I will run after You.
I cannot even want You without Your help.
Pull my heart toward You today.
Make me hungry for Your presence.
Amen.

days.title: Thirst for God
days.verse: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God. My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
lines: Lord,
as the deer pants for the water brooks,
so my soul pants for You.
I am thirsty for the living God.
Let nothing else satisfy me
until I have been with You.
Amen.

days.title: Confess and Be Healed
days.verse: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
lines: Lord,
You tell us to confess our faults to one another
and pray for one another, so that we may be healed.
Give me the humility to be honest,
and a friend I can pray with.
Amen.

days.title: The Prayer of Faith
days.verse: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You said whatever I ask in prayer, believe that I receive it.
Increase my faith as I pray.
Let me pray expecting You to answer,
not just hoping You might.
Amen.

days.title: My Prayer Like Incense
days.verse: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
lines: Lord,
let my prayer come before You like incense,
and the lifting of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
Receive my prayer tonight.
Let it rise to You like a sweet fragrance.
Amen.

days.title: Gethsemane
days.verse: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
lines: Father,
Jesus prayed, Not my will, but thine, be done.
I bring You what I want today.
But more than that, I want Your will.
Give me the strength to pray as He did.
Amen.

days.title: Listen
days.verse: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
lines: Lord,
I will hear what You will speak.
I talk so much in prayer.
Teach me to listen.
Speak peace to Your people,
and let me be still enough to hear it.
Amen.

days.title: Two or Three
days.verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
lines: Jesus,
where two or three gather in Your name, You are there.
Thank You for praying friends.
Bless the people I pray with.
Let us agree in prayer and see You move.
Amen.

days.title: Pour Out Your Heart
days.verse: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
lines: Lord,
You tell me to pour out my heart before You.
I do not have to tidy up my feelings first.
Here is everything I feel today.
You are a refuge for me.
Amen.

days.title: Hannah's Prayer
days.verse: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
lines: Lord,
Hannah poured out her soul before You in tears.
You heard her and answered.
I bring my deepest longing to You today.
Hear me as You heard her.
Amen.

days.title: Watch and Pray
days.verse: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
lines: Lord,
the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.
Help me watch and pray so I do not fall into temptation.
When I am tired, keep my heart awake to You.
Amen.

days.title: Praise Before the Answer
days.verse: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
lines: Lord,
Paul and Silas prayed and sang praises at midnight in prison.
Teach me to praise You in my midnight.
Before the chains fall and the doors open,
let my heart sing to You
in the dark.
Amen.

days.title: Your Face I Seek
days.verse: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
lines: Lord,
when You said, Seek my face,
my heart said to You, Your face, Lord, will I seek.
I do not only want Your answers.
I seek more than Your gifts.
I seek You,
and You are enough.
Amen.

days.title: Every Thought Captive
days.verse: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ.
lines: Lord,
bring every thought into captivity
to the obedience of Christ.
