When my mind wanders during prayer,
gently bring it back to You.
Silence the anxious thoughts and the proud ones,
and fill my mind with Your truth.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord's Presence
days.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
lines: Lord,
You said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
I do not want to go anywhere without You.
Let Your presence go with me today.
Amen.

days.title: Draw Near with Confidence
days.verse: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
lines: Father,
I come boldly to Your throne of grace,
not because I am good,
but because Jesus made the way.
Let me find mercy and grace to help in my time of need.
Amen.

days.title: A House of Prayer
days.verse: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
lines: Lord,
Your house shall be called a house of prayer for all people.
Make my home a house of prayer.
Make my heart a house of prayer.
Thank You for drawing me deeper this month.
Amen.

days.title: The Beginning of Wisdom
days.verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
lines: Lord,
the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
Before I am clever, let me be reverent.
Teach me to honour You first in every choice this month,
and let wisdom grow from there.
Amen.

days.title: Wisdom from Above
days.verse: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
lines: Father,
the wisdom from above is pure, peaceable and gentle,
easy to be entreated and full of mercy.
Give me that kind of wisdom today,
not the kind that wins arguments,
but the kind that brings peace.
Amen.

days.title: Solomon's Request
days.verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
lines: Lord,
Solomon asked for an understanding heart
to know good from bad.
I ask the same today.
Give me a listening heart
for the people and the choices in front of me.
Amen.

days.title: Counsel
days.verse: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
lines: Father,
where there is no counsel the people fall,
but in many counsellors there is safety.
Bring wise people into my life.
Give me the humility to ask for advice
and the sense to take it.
Amen.

days.title: The Narrow Way
days.verse: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the gate is narrow and the way is hard that leads to life.
Many choose the easy road.
Give me courage to choose Your way today,
even when it is the harder one.
Amen.

days.title: Guard My Heart
days.verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
lines: Lord,
help me keep my heart with all diligence,
for out of it flow the issues of life.
Guard what I watch, what I listen to
and who I allow to shape me.
Amen.

days.title: Slow to Speak
days.verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.
lines: Lord,
make me swift to hear, slow to speak and slow to wrath.
I often speak before I think.
Today, help me listen first,
pause before I answer,
and let my words be wise.
Amen.

days.title: Choose This Day
days.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
lines: Lord,
Joshua said, Choose you this day whom ye will serve.
As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.
I make that choice again today
for myself and for my home.
Amen.

days.title: Money Wisdom
days.verse: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
lines: Lord,
everything I have comes from You.
Teach me to honour You with my money
and with the first of all my increase.
Make me wise with spending and generous in giving.
Free me from the love of money.
Amen.

days.title: Which Way to Go
days.verse: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
lines: Lord,
You promise that my ears will hear a word behind me saying,
This is the way, walk ye in it.
I am at a crossroads.
Speak clearly,
and give me courage to turn when You say turn.
Amen.

days.title: Count the Cost
days.verse: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
lines: Lord Jesus,
You told us to sit down and count the cost before we build.
Keep me from rushing into big decisions.
Give me patience to plan
and wisdom to finish what I start.
Amen.

days.title: Wise Friends
days.verse: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
lines: Father,
he that walks with wise men shall be wise.
Show me who I am walking with.
Give me friends who draw me closer to You,
and make me a wise friend to others.
Amen.

days.title: Discernment
days.verse: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment; That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.
lines: Lord,
let my love grow in knowledge and in all judgment,
so I can tell what is excellent.
Give me discernment about what I read and hear,
and keep me sincere and without offence.
Amen.

days.title: Built on the Rock
days.verse: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.
lines: Jesus,
the wise man hears Your words and does them.
He builds his house on the rock.
Let me not only hear Your word today but do it,
so that when storms come, my house stands.
Amen.

days.title: A Wise Tongue
days.verse: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
lines: Lord,
death and life are in the power of the tongue.
Let me speak life today.
Over my children, my spouse, my friends and myself,
let my words build up and bless.
Amen.

days.title: Walk Circumspectly
days.verse: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
lines: Lord,
help me walk carefully, not as a fool but as wise,
redeeming the time.
Do not let me waste my hours on what does not matter.
Show me how to use today well.
Amen.

days.title: Mind of Christ
days.verse: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
lines: Lord Jesus,
I have the mind of Christ.
When I face a decision today,
let me think the way You think.
Let Your thoughts guide my choices
instead of fear or pride.
Amen.

days.title: Patience in Decisions
days.verse: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
lines: Father,
he that hastens with his feet sins.
Keep me from hasty choices made in panic.
Slow me down until I have prayed.
Let me act from peace and not from pressure.
Amen.

days.title: Simple Obedience
days.verse: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
lines: Lord,
to obey is better than sacrifice.
I do not need to do something grand for You today.
Help me simply obey what You have already told me,
in the small things right in front of me.
Amen.

days.title: Hidden Treasure
days.verse: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding; If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures; Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
lines: Lord,
I cry out for understanding
and search for it like hidden treasure.
Let me dig into Your word today
the way people dig for silver,
and let me find You there.
Amen.

days.title: The Fool Says
days.verse: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
lines: Lord,
the fool says in his heart, There is no God.
Keep me from living as if You are not watching.
Let my private choices show that I believe You are real
and that You see.
Amen.

days.title: Be Not Wise in Your Own Eyes
days.verse: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
lines: Lord,
keep me from being wise in my own eyes.
When I am sure I am right, humble me.
Teach me to fear You and to depart from evil,
and let me stay teachable all my life.
Amen.

days.title: Light for the Path
days.verse: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
lines: Lord,
the entrance of Your words gives light.
It gives understanding to the simple.
I feel simple and unsure today.
Open Your word to me and let it light my way.
Amen.

days.title: Generous Wisdom
days.verse: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
lines: Father,
the liberal soul shall be made fat,
and he that waters shall be watered himself.
Make me wise enough to be generous.
Let me pour into others
and trust You to refill me.
Amen.

days.title: Integrity
days.verse: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
lines: Lord,
he that walks uprightly walks surely.
Give me integrity when no one is watching.
Let my yes be yes and my no be no.
Keep me honest in small things and in big things.
Amen.

days.title: Wise as Serpents
days.verse: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
lines: Jesus,
You sent us out as sheep among wolves.
Make me wise as a serpent and harmless as a dove.
Give me street sense and a pure heart,
so I am neither naive nor cruel.
Amen.

days.title: Teachable Spirit
days.verse: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
lines: Lord,
whoever loves instruction loves knowledge.
Give me a teachable spirit.
When I am corrected, let me listen instead of defending myself,
and grow because of it.
Amen.

days.title: The Wise Woman Builds
days.verse: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
lines: Lord,
every wise woman builds her house,
but the foolish plucks it down with her hands.
Help me build my home with wisdom,
with patience and kind words,
one day at a time.
Amen.

days.title: Let Peace Decide
days.verse: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
lines: Lord,
let the peace of God rule in my heart.
When I cannot decide, let Your peace be my guide.
Where there is no peace, let me wait.
And give me a thankful heart while I do.
Amen.

days.title: A Wise Heart Rejoices
days.verse: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
lines: Father,
thank You for the wisdom You have given me this month.
Keep growing it in me.
Let my choices bring You joy,
and let my heart be glad that I chose Your way.
Amen.

days.title: Higher Wisdom
days.verse: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
lines: Lord,
O the depth of the riches both of Your wisdom and knowledge!
How unsearchable are Your judgments.
I end this month in wonder.
You are wiser than all my best plans.
Amen.

days.title: Saved by Grace
days.verse: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
lines: Father,
by grace I am saved through faith,
and it is not from me. It is Your gift.
I did not earn it and I cannot lose it by trying too hard.
Let this month teach me to live in grace.
Amen.

days.title: Grace Upon Grace
days.verse: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
lines: Lord Jesus,
out of Your fullness I have received grace upon grace.
Wave after wave of it.
When I feel I have used up Your patience,
remind me there is always more grace.
Amen.

days.title: Forgiving Myself
days.verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
lines: Father,
as far as the east is from the west,
so far have You removed my sins from me.
If You have let them go,
help me stop digging them up.
Teach me to forgive myself.
Amen.

days.title: Seventy Times Seven
days.verse: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
lines: Jesus,
Peter asked how many times he should forgive.
You said, seventy times seven.
I am tired of forgiving this person.
Give me grace to forgive again,
and again, as You forgive me.
Amen.

days.title: Where Sin Abounded
days.verse: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.
lines: Lord,
where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.
My failures are real,
but Your grace is bigger.
Let me stand today in grace
and not in shame.
Amen.

days.title: Grace for the Humble
days.verse: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
lines: Father,
You resist the proud but give grace to the humble.
Humble me today,
not with shame but with honesty.
Let me receive the grace You give
to those who know they need it.
Amen.

days.title: Throw the First Stone
days.verse: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
lines: Jesus,
You told the crowd, He that is without sin, let him first cast a stone.
Keep me from judging others harshly.
Let me remember my own need of grace
before I point at anyone else.
Amen.

days.title: Go and Sin No More
days.verse: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
lines: Jesus,
You said to the woman, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
Thank You for not condemning me.
Give me the strength to walk away from the sin
You have already forgiven.
Amen.

days.title: Mercy Not Sacrifice
days.verse: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
lines: Lord,
You desire mercy and not sacrifice.
I try to impress You with effort,
but You want a merciful heart.
Make me merciful today,
to others and to myself.
Amen.

days.title: Clean Slate
days.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
lines: Father,
if I confess my sins, You are faithful and just to forgive me
and to cleanse me from all unrighteousness.
I confess them now.
Thank You for a clean slate this morning.
Amen.

days.title: Let Go of Bitterness
days.verse: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
lines: Lord,
I put away all bitterness, wrath and anger.
I do not want to carry them anymore.
Make me kind and tenderhearted.
Help me forgive as God in Christ forgave me.
Amen.

days.title: Grace in My Words
days.verse: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
lines: Lord,
let my speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt.
When I talk to the people who frustrate me,
let grace come out first.
Give me the right answer for every person.
Amen.

days.title: The Returning Son
days.verse: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.
lines: Father,
when the son came home You did not lecture him.
You put the best robe on him.
Thank You for receiving me the same way.
Let me walk today wearing Your robe of grace.
Amen.

days.title: Undeserved Kindness
days.verse: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost.
lines: Lord,
You saved me not because of anything good I did,
but according to Your mercy.
Wash me again today
and renew me by Your Holy Spirit.
Amen.

days.title: Peter Restored
days.verse: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
lines: Jesus,
Peter denied You three times,
and You gave him three chances to say, I love You.
Thank You for restoring me after I fail.
Lord, You know all things. You know I love You.
Amen.

days.title: Forgive Us Our Debts
days.verse: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
lines: Father,
forgive me my debts, as I forgive my debtors.
I cannot ask for one and refuse the other.
Give me the grace to release those who owe me,
as You have released me.
Amen.

days.title: His Mercy Endures
days.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
lines: Lord,
I give You thanks, for You are good,
and Your mercy endures for ever.
Not for a day, not for a season.
For ever.
Let this truth hold me today.
Amen.

days.title: Joseph Forgave
days.verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
lines: Lord,
Joseph's brothers meant evil against him,
but You meant it for good.
Help me see what You can do
with what others meant for harm,
and let me forgive as Joseph did.
Amen.

days.title: No Longer Slaves
days.verse: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You set me free.
Help me stand fast in that freedom
and not go back under the yoke of guilt and rules.
Let me live today as a child of grace.
Amen.

days.title: Grace to the Undeserving
days.verse: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
lines: Father,
You showed Your love for me in that while I was still a sinner,
Christ died for me.
You did not wait for me to be good.
Let that grace make me gracious to others.
Amen.

days.title: A Gentle Restoring
days.verse: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
lines: Lord,
when a brother or sister falls,
help me restore them gently,
remembering that I can fall too.
Keep me from gossip and pride.
Make me a safe place for the broken.
Amen.

days.title: Blot Out My Sins
days.verse: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
lines: Lord,
You blot out my sins for Your own sake
and You will not remember them.
If You choose to forget,
help me stop rehearsing them.
Let me live forgiven.
Amen.

days.title: Healing for Shame
days.verse: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
lines: Lord,
those who looked to You were radiant,
and their faces were not ashamed.
I look to You now.
Lift the shame from my face
and let me shine with Your grace.
Amen.

days.title: The Thief on the Cross
days.verse: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
lines: Jesus,
the thief said, Lord, remember me,
and You promised him paradise that same day.
It is never too late with You.
Remember me too,
and remember those I love who are far from You.
Amen.

days.title: When I Am Weak
days.verse: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
lines: Lord,
Paul learned to say, When I am weak, then am I strong.
I do not like my weakness.
But if it keeps me leaning on You,
let me make peace with it.
Let Your grace be my strength today.
Amen.

days.title: Reconciled
days.verse: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation.
lines: Father,
You reconciled me to Yourself through Christ
and gave me the ministry of reconciliation.
Show me one broken relationship I can help mend.
Give me the courage to take the first step.
Amen.

days.title: Forgiving My Parents
days.verse: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;) That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
lines: Lord,
You tell me to honour my father and mother.
Some of what they did hurt me.
Help me forgive what needs forgiving
and honour them with grace,
so it may be well with me.
Amen.

days.title: Grace Teaches Us
days.verse: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world.
lines: Father,
Your grace has appeared and it teaches me.
It teaches me to say no to ungodliness
and to live soberly and righteously today.
Let grace be my teacher, not fear.
Amen.

days.title: No Record of Wrongs
days.verse: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil.
lines: Lord,
love keeps no record of wrongs.
I have been keeping a list.
Today I tear it up.
Help me not to rewrite it tomorrow.
Amen.

days.title: Amazing Grace
days.verse: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work.
lines: Father,
You are able to make all grace abound toward me.
Thank You for every grace I received this month,
the forgiveness, the second chances, the mercy.
Let me always have enough to share.
Amen.

days.title: Pray for My Nation
days.verse: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
lines: Lord,
You told Your people to seek the peace of the city where they lived
and to pray for it.
Today I pray for my nation.
Give our leaders wisdom and honesty.
Let there be peace, justice and bread for all.
Amen.

days.title: Count It All Joy
days.verse: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
lines: Lord,
You tell me to count it all joy when I face trials.
That is hard to do.
Let patience have its perfect work in me,
so that I come out of this trial complete,
lacking nothing.
Amen.

days.title: Endure Hardness
days.verse: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
lines: Lord Jesus,
help me endure hardness as a good soldier.
Not every day is easy.
Give me the discipline to keep going
when I want to give up.
Amen.

days.title: Not Forsaken
days.verse: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed.
lines: Lord,
I am persecuted but not forsaken,
struck down but not destroyed.
Life has knocked me down.
But I am still here, and You are still with me.
Help me get up again.
Amen.

days.title: Job's Faith
days.verse: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
lines: Lord,
Job said, Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him.
I do not understand what is happening.
But I choose to trust You still,
even here.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Is Near
days.verse: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
lines: Lord,
You are near to the brokenhearted
and You save those of a crushed spirit.
I am crushed today.
Come near.
Hold me close.
Amen.

days.title: Weeping Endures a Night
days.verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
lines: Father,
weeping may endure for a night,
but joy comes in the morning.
I am still in the night.
Give me strength to wait for the morning
You have promised.
Amen.

days.title: Patient in Tribulation
days.verse: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
lines: Lord,
teach me to rejoice in hope,
to be patient in tribulation,
and to keep praying.
When the trouble goes on and on,
let my prayers go on longer.
Amen.

days.title: Light Affliction
days.verse: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.
lines: Lord,
this affliction feels heavy,
but You call it light and short
compared with the glory that is coming.
Help me see my trouble
from the view of eternity.
Amen.

days.title: Refined Like Gold
days.verse: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ.
lines: Father,
the trial of my faith is more precious than gold
tried in the fire.
Use this fire to purify me,
not destroy me.
Let my faith come out stronger.
Amen.

days.title: Keep Going
days.verse: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
lines: Lord,
I need patience so that after I have done Your will,
I may receive the promise.
I am close to quitting.
Give me patience for one more day
and then the next.
Amen.

days.title: Joseph's Waiting
days.verse: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
lines: Lord,
Joseph waited until the time that his word came.
Your word tested him while he waited.
Keep me faithful in my waiting room
until Your time comes.
Amen.

days.title: In the Lions' Den
days.verse: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
lines: Lord,
You sent Your angel and shut the lions' mouths.
Shut the mouths of the lions around me today:
the threats, the lies, the fears.
Keep me safe in the den
until You bring me out.
Amen.

days.title: Do Not Fret
days.verse: [A Psalm of David.] Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
lines: Lord,
keep me from fretting because of evildoers
or being envious of those who seem to win by doing wrong.
You see all of it.
I leave justice in Your hands.
Amen.

days.title: He Holds My Tears
days.verse: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
lines: Lord,
You keep count of my wanderings
and put my tears in Your bottle.
Not one tear has been wasted.
You saw every one.
Comfort me today.
Amen.

days.title: Hope That Anchors
days.verse: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil.
lines: Lord Jesus,
my hope in You is an anchor for my soul,
sure and steadfast.
When the storm pulls at me,
let this anchor hold.
Amen.

days.title: Not in Vain
days.verse: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
lines: Father,
make me steadfast and unmovable,
always abounding in Your work.
Some days it feels like nothing I do for You matters.
Remind me that my labour is not in vain in the Lord.
Amen.

days.title: Wilderness Bread
days.verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
lines: Lord,
You fed Your people with manna in the wilderness
so they would learn that man does not live by bread alone.
Feed me today with Your word.
Teach me in this dry place.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Will Perfect
days.verse: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
lines: Lord,
You will perfect what concerns me.
Your mercy endures for ever.
Do not abandon the work of Your hands.
Finish what You began in my life.
Amen.

days.title: Strength Renewed
days.verse: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
lines: Lord,
You do not faint and You are never weary.
There is no limit to Your understanding.
When my strength runs out,
Yours does not.
Lend me Yours today.
Amen.

days.title: Paul's Contentment
days.verse: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
lines: Lord,
Paul learned to be content in every state,
in plenty and in need.
Teach me that secret.
Whether I have much or little today,
let me be content in You.
Amen.

days.title: After You Have Suffered
days.verse: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
lines: Father,
the God of all grace,
after I have suffered a while,
make me perfect, establish, strengthen and settle me.
Let this season end in strength.
Amen.

days.title: Wait for It
days.verse: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
lines: Lord,
the vision is for an appointed time.
Though it tarries, I will wait for it.
It will surely come.
Keep my hope alive while I wait.
Amen.

days.title: Through Many Tribulations
days.verse: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
lines: Lord,
the apostles taught that we must enter the kingdom through much tribulation.
I am not surprised by trouble anymore.
But I ask for strength to continue in the faith.
Amen.

days.title: Unseen Things
days.verse: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
lines: Lord,
help me look not at the things which are seen,
but at the things which are not seen.
What I see is temporary.
What You are doing is eternal.
Amen.

days.title: Ruth's Loyalty
days.verse: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.
lines: Lord,
Ruth stayed when it would have been easier to leave.
Give me that kind of loyalty
to You and to the people I love,
even in hard seasons.
Amen.

days.title: Still Faithful
days.verse: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
lines: Lord,
even when I am faithless, You remain faithful.
You cannot deny Yourself.
When my faith is weak today,
lean on Your faithfulness.
Amen.

days.title: Night Songs
days.verse: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night.
lines: Lord,
You give songs in the night.
It is dark right now.
Give me a song anyway,
a small song of trust
to carry me until morning.
Amen.

days.title: The Crown
days.verse: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
lines: Lord,
blessed is the one who endures temptation.
When he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life.
Help me endure today,
and keep my eyes on the crown.
Amen.

days.title: He Knows the Way
days.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
lines: Lord,
You know the way that I take.
When You have tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
I may not know the way,
but You do.
Amen.

days.title: Finish the Race
days.verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
lines: Lord,
Paul could say, I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course.
Thank You for carrying me through this month.
Help me keep the faith to the end.
Amen.

days.title: A Great Cloud of Witnesses
days.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us.
lines: Lord,
I am surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses,
the faithful who walked before me.
Thank You for every believer whose life pointed me to You.
Let me run my race well,
so I can point someone else to You too.
Amen.

days.title: Enter with Thanks
days.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
lines: Lord,
I enter Your gates with thanksgiving
and Your courts with praise.
Before I ask for anything today,
I want to say thank You.
Let this month be a month of gratitude.
Amen.

days.title: In Everything Give Thanks
days.verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
lines: Father,
in everything give thanks, for this is Your will for me.
Not for everything, but in everything.
Even in this hard thing,
I can find something to thank You for.
Amen.

days.title: Forget Not His Benefits
days.verse: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
lines: Lord,
bless the Lord, O my soul,
and forget not all His benefits.
I forget so quickly.
Today I remember:
You forgave me, healed me and crowned me with mercy.
Amen.

days.title: The One Who Returned
days.verse: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God, And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
lines: Jesus,
ten lepers were healed, but only one came back to say thank You.
I want to be the one who returns.
Thank You for every prayer You have answered,
the ones I remember and the ones I forgot.
Amen.

days.title: Every Good Gift
days.verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
lines: Father,
every good gift and every perfect gift comes from You.
The food on my table,
the people I love,
the breath in my lungs:
all of it is from You.
Thank You.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Daily Bread
days.verse: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season. Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
lines: Lord,
the eyes of all wait upon You,
and You give them their food in due season.
You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing.
Thank You for providing for me again today.
Amen.

days.title: Count Your Blessings
days.verse: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
lines: Lord,
many are the wonderful works You have done,
and Your thoughts toward me cannot be counted.
Let me count a few of them today,
and let my heart overflow.
Amen.

days.title: A Thankful Heart
days.verse: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
lines: Lord Jesus,
as I received You, let me walk in You,
rooted and built up in You,
and abounding with thanksgiving.
Let gratitude be my first response today,
not complaint.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for the Church
days.verse: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you.
lines: Father,
I thank God every time I remember the people of my church.
Thank You for those who pray for me,
teach me and stand with me.
Bless them richly today.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks in the Valley
days.verse: [A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
lines: Lord,
I will bless You at all times.
Your praise shall continually be in my mouth.
Even on the hard days.
Even today.
Let my mouth be full of thanks.
Amen.

days.title: Content with What I Have
days.verse: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
lines: Lord,
keep my life free from the love of money
and help me be content with what I have.
You have promised You will never leave me nor forsake me.
That is enough.
Amen.

days.title: Godliness with Contentment
days.verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out. And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
lines: Father,
godliness with contentment is great gain.
I brought nothing into this world and I can carry nothing out.
If I have food and clothing,
teach me to be content.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Salvation
days.verse: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
lines: Father,
thanks be to You for Your unspeakable gift.
Jesus is the greatest gift I have ever received.
No words are enough.
Let my life be my thank You.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Family
days.verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
lines: Lord,
children are a gift from You.
Thank You for my family,
for every child, parent, sibling and relative You have given me.
Help me treasure them while I have them.
Amen.

days.title: Sing with Grace
days.verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
lines: Lord,
let Your word dwell in me richly.
Fill my heart with psalms, hymns and spiritual songs.
Let me sing with grace in my heart to You today,
even if only in a whisper.
Amen.

days.title: The Lord Has Done Great Things
days.verse: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
lines: Lord,
You have done great things for us, and we are glad.
Let me remember the great things You did this year
and tell someone about them today.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Small Things
days.verse: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
lines: Father,
not one sparrow falls without You knowing.
You care about small things.
Thank You for the small mercies today:
a kind word, a warm meal, a moment of peace.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks Before the Miracle
days.verse: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
lines: Jesus,
before Lazarus came out, You lifted Your eyes and said,
Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
Teach me to thank God before I see the answer.
Amen.

days.title: A Sacrifice of Praise
days.verse: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
lines: Lord,
I offer You a sacrifice of praise,
the fruit of my lips giving thanks to Your name.
When praise costs me something today,
let me give it anyway.
Amen.

days.title: Generous Because Blessed
days.verse: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
lines: Father,
You love a cheerful giver.
Make me generous today,
not grudgingly or under pressure,
but because I am so thankful for what You gave me.
Amen.

days.title: My Cup Runs Over
days.verse: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
lines: Lord,
You prepare a table before me
and my cup runs over.
I have more than I notice.
Open my eyes to how full my cup really is,
and let it spill over to others.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Friends
days.verse: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
lines: Lord,
ointment and perfume rejoice the heart,
and so does the sweetness of a friend's counsel.
Thank You for friends who tell me the truth in love.
Bless them today.
Amen.

days.title: Rejoice in the Lord
days.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
lines: Lord,
I rejoice in You always, and again I say, rejoice.
Not because everything is good,
but because You are always good.
Let joy rise in me today.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Each Day
days.verse: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
lines: Lord,
You crown the year with Your goodness
and Your paths drop fatness.
As this year comes near its end,
thank You for every day You crowned with goodness.
Amen.

days.title: Grateful for Grace
days.verse: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
lines: Lord,
by the grace of God I am what I am.
Everything good in me came from You.
Let me never forget where I came from
or who brought me this far.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for Rest
days.verse: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
lines: Lord,
return unto your rest, O my soul,
for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.
Thank You for dealing so kindly with me.
Let my soul rest in thanks today.
Amen.

days.title: Thanks for the Harvest
days.verse: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
lines: Lord,
the earth has yielded her increase,
and You, our own God, bless us.
Thank You for every harvest this year,
in my work, my family and my faith.
Amen.

days.title: A Grateful Witness
days.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever. Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy.
lines: Lord,
I give thanks, for You are good and Your mercy endures for ever.
Let the redeemed of the Lord say so.
I say so today.
You redeemed me and I am grateful.
Amen.

days.title: Thankful Heart, Open Hands
days.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
lines: Lord,
I give thanks to You, for You are good.
Your mercy endures for ever.
Thank You for teaching me gratitude this month.
Keep my heart thankful and my hands open.
Amen.

days.title: Prepare the Way
days.verse: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
lines: Lord,
a voice cries, Prepare ye the way of the Lord.
As Christmas comes near,
prepare my heart for You.
Clear away the clutter and the rush,
and make room for joy.
Amen.

days.title: Good Tidings
days.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
lines: Lord,
how beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news.
Make me a bringer of good news this month,
to my family, my neighbours and my friends.
Let my words carry hope.
Amen.

days.title: Joy Unspeakable
days.verse: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory.
lines: Lord Jesus,
I have not seen You,
yet I love You and rejoice with joy unspeakable.
Fill me with that joy today,
the joy that does not depend on how my day goes.
Amen.

days.title: The People Who Walked in Darkness
days.verse: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
lines: Lord,
the people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
Shine Your light on those sitting in darkness this season,
the lonely, the grieving and the lost.
Amen.

days.title: A Child Is Born
days.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
lines: Lord Jesus,
unto us a child is born,
Wonderful Counsellor, Mighty God,
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
Be all of these to me today.
Amen.

days.title: Joy in Community
days.verse: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart, Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
lines: Father,
the early church ate together with gladness and singleness of heart.
Bless my church family this season.
Let us share meals, laughter and praise,
and let others want to join us.
Amen.

days.title: Good Things to Come
days.verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
lines: God of hope,
fill me with all joy and peace in believing,
so that I may abound in hope
by the power of the Holy Spirit.
Let my hope spill over today.
Amen.

days.title: Emmanuel
days.verse: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
lines: Lord,
they shall call His name Emmanuel, God with us.
You are not far away.
You came close.
Let me feel Your nearness today
in every ordinary moment.
Amen.

days.title: My Soul Magnifies
days.verse: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
lines: Lord,
like Mary, my soul magnifies You
and my spirit rejoices in God my Saviour.
You have done great things for me.
Let my life make You look bigger to others.
Amen.

days.title: Joy of Salvation
days.verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
lines: Lord,
with joy shall I draw water out of the wells of salvation.
Let me draw from those wells today.
Refresh my joy in what Jesus has done for me.
Amen.

days.title: Gentleness Known
days.verse: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
lines: Lord,
let my gentleness be known to everyone.
The Lord is at hand.
In the rush of the season,
let me be gentle with the people around me.
Amen.

days.title: Waiting with Hope
days.verse: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
lines: Lord,
Simeon waited for the consolation of Israel,
and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
Teach me to wait for Your promises
with hope and expectation,
like he did.
Amen.

days.title: Gifts of the Magi
days.verse: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the wise men opened their treasures and gave You gifts.
What can I give You this Christmas?
I give You my heart,
my time and my worship.
Amen.

days.title: Praise with Joy
days.verse: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
lines: Lord,
I make a joyful noise to You.
I break out in song and rejoice.
Let my home be full of joyful praise this season,
not just noise and stress.
Amen.

days.title: Good Will Toward Men
days.verse: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
lines: Lord,
glory to God in the highest,
and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Let me spread peace and good will this season,
even to those who are hard to love.
Amen.

days.title: For the Lonely at Christmas
days.verse: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
lines: Lord,
turn to me and have mercy, for I am lonely and afflicted.
I pray for everyone who feels alone this Christmas.
Surround them with love
and let them know You are near.
Amen.

days.title: The Word Became Flesh
days.verse: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us.
You moved into the neighbourhood.
Thank You for coming close.
Let me see Your glory, full of grace and truth.
Amen.

days.title: Fullness of Joy
days.verse: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
lines: Lord,
in Your presence is fullness of joy,
and at Your right hand are pleasures for evermore.
Show me the path of life today
and let me walk it with joy.
Amen.

days.title: Rejoicing Together
days.verse: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
lines: Lord,
help me rejoice with those who rejoice
and weep with those who weep.
Make me present for my friends this season,
in their happiness and in their sorrow.
Amen.

days.title: Joseph's Obedience
days.verse: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife.
lines: Lord,
Joseph woke up and did what the angel commanded.
He obeyed without fully understanding.
Give me that quiet obedience,
even when Your plans surprise me.
Amen.

days.title: The Shortest Days
days.verse: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the light shines in the darkness,
and the darkness has not overcome it.
On these short dark days,
let Your light burn bright in me.
Amen.

days.title: Make Room
days.verse: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
lines: Lord Jesus,
there was no room for You in the inn.
Do not let my life be so full that there is no room for You.
Clear a space in my heart
and come in.
Amen.

days.title: Shepherds Heard First
days.verse: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
lines: Lord,
You announced the birth of Jesus to ordinary shepherds working the night shift.
Thank You that You come to ordinary people.
Find me in my ordinary work today.
Amen.

days.title: Silent Night
days.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
lines: Lord,
unto us is born this day in the city of David a Saviour,
which is Christ the Lord.
On this holy night,
quiet my heart to wonder again
at the gift of Your Son.
Amen.

days.title: Christmas Day
days.verse: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
lines: Lord Jesus,
today the angel's words are true for me:
Fear not, I bring you good tidings of great joy.
Happy birthday, King.
Thank You for coming.
Let joy fill my home today.
Amen.

days.title: Treasure These Things
days.verse: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
lines: Lord,
Mary kept all these things and pondered them in her heart.
After the busy day,
let me treasure what You showed me this Christmas
and keep it close.
Amen.

days.title: They Returned Praising
days.verse: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
lines: Lord,
the shepherds returned glorifying and praising God
for all they had heard and seen.
Let me go back to ordinary life
praising You for what I have seen.
Amen.

days.title: Fellowship
days.verse: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
lines: Father,
our fellowship is with You and with Your Son Jesus.
Thank You for the people I have shared this season with.
Let our fellowship be real and our joy full.
Amen.

days.title: Goodness and Mercy
days.verse: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
lines: Lord,
surely goodness and mercy have followed me all the days of this year.
Thank You.
Let them follow me into the next one,
and let me dwell in Your house for ever.
Amen.

days.title: Hitherto
days.verse: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
lines: Lord,
Samuel set up a stone and called it Ebenezer,
saying, Hitherto hath the Lord helped us.
I set up my stone today.
You have helped me all the way this year.
Amen.

days.title: Crossover
days.verse: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
lines: Faithful God,
thank You for carrying me through this year,
the good days and the hard ones.
As I cross into a new year,
I bring You my hopes and my fears.
Do a new thing, Lord.
I am ready.
Amen.

moveable.title: Return to Me
moveable.verse: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
lines: Lord,
rend my heart and not my garments.
On this first day of Lent,
I turn back to You.
You are gracious and merciful,
slow to anger and of great kindness.
Walk with me these forty days.
Amen.

moveable.title: Hosanna
moveable.verse: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
lines: Lord Jesus,
the crowds shouted, Hosanna, blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord.
I lay my palm branch before You today.
Be King in my life,
not only on the easy days but all week long.
Amen.

moveable.title: It Is Finished
moveable.verse: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
lines: Jesus,
You said, It is finished,
and You bowed Your head and gave up Your spirit.
Everything needed to save me was finished on that cross.
I kneel in wonder today.
Thank You for dying in my place.
Amen.

moveable.title: He Is Risen
moveable.verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
lines: Risen Lord,
He is not here, for He is risen, as He said.
The grave is empty and death has lost.
Raise up in me every hope that died.
Let me live today
in the power of Your resurrection.
Hallelujah. Amen.

moveable.title: He Will Come Again
moveable.verse: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
lines: Lord Jesus,
You went up into heaven,
and You will come again in the same way.
Help me live today ready for Your return,
working faithfully until I see You face to face.
Amen.

moveable.title: Come, Holy Spirit
moveable.verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
lines: Holy Spirit,
on the day of Pentecost You filled them all.
Fill me again today.
